finding: Independent produced row payloads could share one reservation by cloning or by reacquiring a shared-key registration, undercounting resident workspace.
fix: Produced-row path admits only exclusive, non-shared-key reservations; generic send_reserved remains unchanged.
boundaries: Controlled internal API counterexamples. The normal row producer creates fresh reservations, so no real production trigger is claimed. Not full tests, IPC, exhaustive concurrency, allocation measurement or RSS qualification.
